title: Allow the possibility of attaching photos and external files to features, as well as chat
description: A user must be able to specify external file links in a Feature that will be sent to the LLM. This must be used inside the orchestrator and inside Chat.

features.title: Update Feature and CompletionMessage types to support file attachments
features.description: Modify the `Feature` and `CompletionMessage` types in `src/types.ts` to include an optional `files` field, which will be an array of strings representing file paths or URLs.

features.title: Update completion to support file attachments in messages
features.description: Modify the chat message functions in @src/completion.ts to handle an optional `files` array provided by the user. Follow the same idea as the @src/orchestrator.ts

features.title: Update orchestrator to include file attachments
features.description: Modify the @src/orchestrator.ts to process the `files` field from both features. The orchestrator must be updated to format and include the content from these files in the context provided to the LLM.

features.title: Unify the code for completion that is shared between chatTools and orchestrator
features.description: There should be only one good access point to sending LLM completions and that should be via @src/completion.ts - make sure that any code that is shared between @src/tools/chatTools.ts and @src/orchestrator.ts is actually in @src/completion.ts and is shared appropriately.
